notes.title: Small Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
A suggestion we received from our discord suggested we add a button that copies the lobby code so they don't have to type it out which we thought was genius!

We've added:
- a button in the lobby that copies the lobby code to clipboard so you can paste it elsewhere to your hearts content
- The lobby code is now hidden by default, but with a button that when pressed shows it or hides it. This way if you are screen sharing or streaming people won't just swarm your lobby 

If you have any other suggestions, be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]discord[/url] and let us know!

In other news, we've started our next game a few weeks ago! It's going to be a 2D single player roguelike auto battler with some idler mechanics. Our goals for this project is to set up an online leaderboard, steam achievements, and create an expansive ability system for you all to experiment with!

In case you want to follow a long, be sure to check out our socials:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@SleeperBuildDev/videos]Youtube[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@sleeperbuilddev]Tik Tok[/url]
[url=https://x.com/SleeperBuildDev]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/sleeperbuildstudio/]Instagram[/url]

Or if you are feeling like you want to support us even more, we now have a Patreon (Sleeper Build Dev)!

notes.title: In game chat and a few more bug fixes!
notes.content:
The main highlight of this patch is a [u][b]new in game chat[/b][/u] that can be accessed in the shop by pressing tab to open it, then press enter to start typing. We are testing it out though, so with your feedback we will be improving it on how you all think we should! Apart from this, we also fixed a few more small things we noticed:

[list]
[*] Improvements to wording in tutorial
[*] Some controller graphics was incorrect in the settings
[*] Token item was broken (I did this with last patch, whoops)
[*] A few controller improvements
[*] Increased ghost landmine cooldown for balancing reasons
[/list]

notes.title: Post Release Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We really appreciate all the positive reception we got on the first day and it was a ton of fun to play with everyone! Below are some of the things we noticed yesterday that snuck by use before release. If you notice anything else off, either broken or balanced poorly, please reach out to use on the steam community forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]Discord[/url]! 

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed The waypoints for some of the caves being incorrect for the wall causing it to stop prematurely
[*] Fixed Idol not scoring when nakey is activated and held by client, then that client is given the idol to hold
[*] Fixed Sign in shop hiding the name of the roller for clients after it gets rolled once
[*] Fixed Ready up can get inverted if client readies up while game is starting
[*] Fixed Boombox breaking the items after tripping with another boombox in inventory if they are next to each other in inventory and in a specific orientation (Don’t ask). This also caused some other items to break if this happened, so all those are fixed now too.
[*] Fixed Host can buy items in first shop but clients cannot
[*] Changed give card name in shop to curse wand
[*] Fixed Trip mine desc grammer
[*] Fixed blackout curse description
[*] Fixed mine description
[*] Fixed Hot potato collider blocking guns
[/list]


[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Distance from where you can place traps as ghost
[*] Make immune while frozen from respawn and speed up a little (from chameleon too)
[*] Reduce trip mine card activation
[*] Turned off comeback speed boost when wall is disabled
[/list]


[b]Additions & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Sfx when someone joins lobby
[*] Change eye laser particle color
[/list]


And in case you missed it, here is kind of a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j8c9qRzdrKA&t=310s&ab_channel=SleeperBuildDev]recap[/url] of our development process!
[previewyoutube=j8c9qRzdrKA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
